scope: Disposable files and processes on an ephemeral GitHub macOS runner only
interpretation: The scoped trace observed file-path controls before and after the owned writer actions, but none of its matching write-call lines named the file opened before tracing. The PID filter excludes kernel write-back, so the mapping field does not assess that path. Pipe acknowledgements contribute to unnamed write lines. This experiment does not prove complete path or writer coverage and cannot certify a production no-writer hold.
